import time, io
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ID,'android:id/button_once').click()
WebDriverWait(driver,5).until(lambda d: d.current_package=='org.videolan.vlc')
frames=[]
t0=time.monotonic()
for i in range(35):
    png=driver.get_screenshot_as_png()
    frames.append((time.monotonic()-t0, Image.open(io.BytesIO(png)).convert('RGB')))
    target=t0+(i+1)*0.7
    time.sleep(max(0,target-time.monotonic()))
# video viewport is center band y 795..1605 on 1080x2400 portrait screenshots
thumbs=[]
for t,im in frames:
    crop=im.crop((0,790,1080,1610)).resize((432,328))
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(crop); d.rectangle((0,0,85,24),fill='black'); d.text((4,4),f'{t:04.1f}s',fill='white')
    thumbs.append(crop)
sheets=[]
for start in range(0,len(thumbs),15):
    subset=thumbs[start:start+15]
    sheet=Image.new('RGB',(432*3,328*5),'black')
    for j,im in enumerate(subset): sheet.paste(im,((j%3)*432,(j//3)*328))
    sheets.append(sheet)
for s in sheets: display(s, mime_type='image/jpeg')
{'captured':len(frames),'elapsed':frames[-1][0],'package':driver.current_package}
